_comment: Edit this file to set your searches. Each search needs either a pasted Autotrader motorhome-search URL or a criteria block. See README.md for every supported key.

details._comment: Each new advert's page is fetched once to read its features and description. This caps how many per run; the rest are picked up on later runs.

deals._comment: An advert is 'worth a look' if it has at least minWantedSpecs of the wantedSpecs, or is underpricedPercent below the median of similar live adverts (same make and model, year within 2, at least minComparables of them).
